title: JSFL: document.timeline should be a property, not only getTimeline() method
description: In packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts, the Flash 8 JSFL API defines document.timeline as a property accessor, but currently only doc.getTimeline() is exposed as a method. Real-world JSFL scripts use doc.timeline.layers — accessing doc.timeline returns undefined.layers and throws. Fix: add a get timeline() getter to the JsflDocument proxy that delegates to the same JsflTimeline object that getTimeline() returns.
